messages:
maya: Hey team — quick all-hands note for tomorrow 10am PT. Agenda below, plus a short Q&A doc. Please drop any questions in this thread or add to the doc so we can queue them. :spiral_calendar:

maya: Agenda (25m total):
- 10:00–10:05: CEO update (strategy + hiring ask)
- 10:05–10:12: Product highlight — Dedicated autoscaling improvements (demo)
- 10:12–10:18: Security & policy update — new data retention defaults
- 10:18–10:25: Open Q&A

maya: Q&A doc: https://docs.google.com/QnA-redwood-allhands (add questions, upvote with reactions)

jon: Thanks — can we slot a 2m callout about incident runbook changes? small but important.

maya: @jon yes — we’ll fold that into the Security & policy segment. If you have a one-line summary, paste it here and I’ll include it in the slides.

jon: TL;DR: runbook now auto-escalates to oncall+SRE lead after 3 failed retries, and we added a pre-flight healthcheck step. I’ll paste the exact wording later.

srini: Heads-up: the policy update includes a DEFAULT 90-day index retention for debug logs; opt-out via project settings. We’ll publish migration guidance in the docs during the week.

maya: noted, @srini — can you attach the migration checklist to the Q&A doc before the meeting?

srini: done — added checklist and sample curl for exporting logs:```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/export -d '{"project":"acme","range":"30d"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'```

olivia: Quick reminder for people managers: we’ll have 2 minutes at the end to surface headcount requests. Put requests in the hiring tracker by EOD today.

kate: For folks in APAC — recording & slides will be posted right after, and we’ll run a follow-up office hours at 4pm SGT for any region-specific Qs.

maya: Recording will be uploaded here immediately after the meeting. If you can’t attend, add questions to the doc and we’ll answer in-thread and in the follow-up notes. :white_check_mark:

all-hands-bot: Calendar reminder posted: All-hands — Product + Policy update — Tomorrow 10:00 PT (link in #general)

recording-bot: Recording uploaded: https://records.redwood.co/meetings/1828550000-allhands-spring-sync.mp4 (slides: https://slides.redwood.co/allhands/1828550000)

maya: Post-meeting takeaways (will paste here after):
- CEO: reiterated focus on reliability-first for Q3; hiring ask approved for +3 infra roles.
- Product: Dedicated autoscaling reduces tail latency on 99th p95 by ~18% in internal perf tests.
- Security: default retention change + migration checklist published; opt-out route documented.
- Ops: minor runbook escalation tweak deployed; runbook tests scheduled weekly.

maya: Thanks everyone. If you raised a question in the doc and we didn’t address it live, we’ll reply in this thread and update the public notes.
